Draft affirmative.label: Draft, needs approval
Draft affirmative.say: It cannot become law until Parliament approves it.

Made affirmative.label: Already law, needs approval
Made affirmative.say: It is already law, but it stops being law unless Parliament approves it within a set time.

Draft negative.label: Draft, goes ahead unless a House objects
Draft negative.say: It becomes law unless either House objects within 40 days.

Made negative.label: Already law, unless a House objects
Made negative.say: It is already law, and stays law unless either House objects within 40 days.
